title: Memoizing the user profile lookup
tldr: A module-level TTL cache is added in front of fetchUserProfile and the /me handler reads through it.

readingPlan.step: Read the cache module; the handler change is one line.

concerns.question: What happens when two requests for the same userId miss at the same time?
concerns.why: The check and the set are separate awaits, so concurrent misses both fetch and both write.

chapters.title: A module-level memo in front of the profile fetch
chapters.summary: getUserProfile reads a Map with a 30s TTL and falls through to the auth service on a miss.
chapters.whyMatters: Every profile read in the process now goes through this one map, including concurrent ones.

sections.content: The cache is a plain Map keyed by userId with an expiresAt timestamp, plus an invalidate helper.

chapters.title: The handler switches to the cached read
chapters.summary: meHandler imports getUserProfile instead of fetchUserProfile.
chapters.whyMatters: This is the only call site, so the cache TTL is what the endpoint now returns.

sections.content: One import and one call site change; the response shape is unchanged.
